defs.def: a particular way of doing sth; a particular type of sth 方式；风格；样式

ex.s: Here’s the breakdown of the emissions in 2018 for different modes of transport.
ex.t: 以下是2018年不同交通方式排放量的细分。

ex.s: Each mode of transport has its specific fuel needs.
ex.t: 每种交通方式都有其特定的燃料需求。

ex.s: Which mode of transport can go green comparatively easily?
ex.t: 哪种交通方式相对容易实现绿色化？

defs.def: the way in which a piece of equipment is set to perform a particular task （设备的）模式，工作状态

ex.s: In the first ___49___, “You'd have a lot of kids and be in survival mode, start having kids young, expect your kids will have kids young, and expect that there will be more ___50___ and fewer resources,” said Twenge, a psychology professor at San Diego State University who is the author of “iGen; Why Today’s Super-Connected Kids Are Growing Up Less Rebellious, More Tolerant, Less Happy — and Completely Unprepared  for Adulthood.
ex.t: 在第一种___49___（模式）下，“你会生很多孩子，处于生存模式，早早开始生孩子，预期你的孩子也会早早生孩子，并且预期会有更多___50___（孩子）和更少的资源，”心理学教授Twenge说……

ex.s: When we turn off a device, such a television, it goes into stand-by mode.
ex.t: 当我们关掉一台设备，比如电视机，它就进入了待机模式。

ex.s: Devices in this mode still use power, and older devices in stand-by mode can use even more.
ex.t: 处于这种模式的设备仍然耗电，而较旧的设备在待机模式下耗电更多。

ex.s: The future home will use integrated sensors to tell when you leave home each morning, and then go into an energy-efficient mode all by itself.
ex.t: 未来的家将使用集成传感器来判断每天早上你何时离开家，然后自动进入节能模式。

ex.s: This morning, I saw the shocking headline: “Passenger Dies When Car Crashes in Driverless Mode”.
ex.t: 今天早上，我看到了那则令人震惊的标题：“无人驾驶模式下车祸致乘客死亡”。

ex.s: At this time, your portable electronic devices must “flight mode” or until an announcement upon arrival.
ex.t: 此时，你的便携式电子设备必须______处于“飞行模式”，或直到抵达时通知为止。

defs.def: a particular way of feeling or behaving （情感或行为的）状态，状况
a particular style or fashion in clothes, art, etc. （衣着、艺术等的）形式，风格
a set of notes in music which form a scale （音乐的）调式
the value that appears most frequently in a series of numbers 众数（一组数字中出现次数最多的数）
